_source: Arabic for Shopify's own storefront system strings -- Translate & Adapt calls this group "Checkout & system". These are NOT theme strings: they live on the store as translations of the ONLINE_STORE_THEME_LOCALE_CONTENT resource, keyed by Shopify's key, and Shopify serves English until each one is overridden. Verified 2026-08-07: the Arabic checkout renders in English apart from the keys we have overridden.
_note: Keyed by Shopify's key rather than by English value, because values repeat -- 'Products' alone appears three times with different meanings. Applied by apply-system-strings.py. Placeholders like %{count} and any HTML must survive translation exactly.
_scope: Storefront-facing groups only: page titles, form errors, cart and account notices, sentence connectors, email marketing. Deliberately excluded: shopify.errors.shop_404.*, which is Shopify's own store-unavailable page and talks about free trials and Shopify support, and shopify.checkout.* / customer_accounts.*, which are 3,600+ strings and belong in a bulk pass.
